contentList.content: Masters of the three elemental reagents — Quas, Wex, and Exort. Arcane Invokers combine orbs and Invoke to unleash a vast arsenal of spells.
Conjure a Quas (ice) reagent orb. Hold up to 3 orbs, then Invoke to combine them.
Conjure a Wex (storm) reagent orb. Each Wex held makes movement cost 10% less and grants +1 Initiative. Hold up to 3 orbs, then Invoke to combine them.
Conjure an Exort (fire) reagent orb. Each Exort held adds +1 force damage to your attacks and Arcane Strike. Hold up to 3 orbs, then Invoke to combine them.
Combine your held orbs into a spell. The available combination depends on which orbs you are holding.
EEE — Call down a pinpoint blast of solar fire on any spot you can see, even without a clear line of sight from you. Requires 3 Exort orbs.
QQQ — Chill a foe with biting frost. Requires 3 Quas orbs.
QWE — A blast of force and thunder. Requires one Quas, one Wex, and one Exort.
Gripped by biting frost: taking [1] each turn and slowed.
WWW — Call a storm burst down on a targeted area, dealing lightning damage and Silencing everything caught: two turns on a failed save, one turn on a success.
WEE — Hurl a crashing meteor that deals thunder damage on impact, sets everything it hits ablaze for 3 turns, and leaves a burning fire field behind.
WWE — For 3 turns, a creature is Hasted (extra action, double speed, +2 AC, no exhaustion afterward) with +1d4 to attack rolls and +1d6 damage.
QQW — Turn invisible and slip past your foes. Enemies near you are slowed and burned.
QQE — Draw a wall of ice. It can be walked through, but enemies who cross it are slowed and burned, more fiercely as you level.
QWW — Conjure a lingering cyclone that deals force damage each turn to those caught inside.
QEE — Forge two fire elemental spirits that fight at your side for 4 turns. They grow tougher and hit harder as you level.
A forged fire spirit empowers you: attacks deal +1d6 fire damage and you resist fire.
Loose a bolt of arcane force at a foe. Scales with your level.
Gauntlets attuned to the elemental orbs. While worn, they grant the at-will Arcane Strike and sharpen the wearer's intellect.
